purpose: External works cited across the substrate, with provenance (where_used) computed from the hand-authored docs. Companion to result_registry.json (theorem-name provenance).

sources.title: On the Discrete Logarithm Problem for Prime-Field Elliptic Curves
sources.venue: Finite Fields and Their Applications 51, pp. 168–182
sources.role: Primary source for a one-Gröbner-basis prime-field index-calculus variant and an independent description of the faithful Petit factor base L(x)=0.
sources.note: The open IACR manuscript and publication metadata were inspected. It is prior art for proposal design, not evidence that P4 implemented the method.

sources.title: On the discrete logarithm problem in elliptic curves
sources.role: Asymptotic index-calculus results for ECDLP over extension fields (Gaudry–Diem–Semaev), cited to bound the scope of the Semaev formalization.

sources.title: Speeding up the Discrete Log Computation on Curves with Automorphisms
sources.role: Primary prior art for exploiting curve automorphisms in Pollard rho, including the order-6 automorphism group of j=0 curves and its constant-factor speedup.

sources.title: Using symmetries in the index calculus for elliptic curves discrete logarithm
sources.role: Symmetry-adapted / quasi-homogeneous index calculus — the extension-field precedent for GLV-symmetrized relation systems in HYP_GLV_SEMAEV_001.

sources.title: Symmetrized Summation Polynomials: Using Small Order Torsion Points to Speed Up Elliptic Curve Index Calculus
sources.role: Primary source for torsion-translation symmetries whose coordinatewise relation-preserving subgroup grows with the number of free relation variables.
sources.note: The official IACR archival PDF was inspected. Its torsion-translation mechanism is distinct from the diagonal scalar GLV action.

sources.title: A remark concerning m-divisibility and the discrete logarithm in the divisor class group of curves
sources.role: Frey–Rück (FR) transfer via pairings — with MOV, the attack the embedding-degree bound (EmbeddingDegree.lean) proves secp256k1 resists.

sources.title: Index calculus for abelian varieties of small dimension and the elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem
sources.role: Index calculus for ECDLP over extension fields via Weil restriction — the subexponential regime the prime-field barrier (BARRIERS.md B3) contrasts against.

sources.title: Algorithms for the Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithm and the Approximate Common Divisor Problem
sources.role: Closest prior treatment of a curve automorphism acting simultaneously on a Semaev relation system, including target transport, invariant coordinates, and negative polynomial-solving observations in characteristic 3.
sources.note: The primary thesis PDF is hosted on an official University of Auckland faculty page. No DOI or canonical institutional-repository identifier was confirmed.

sources.title: Faster Point Multiplication on Elliptic Curves with Efficient Endomorphisms
sources.role: Primary source for the GLV scalar decomposition and the efficient endomorphism used by secp256k1.

sources.title: Acceleration of Index Calculus for Solving ECDLP over Prime Fields and Its Limitation
sources.role: Prior art for hybrid Gröbner acceleration and summation-polynomial symmetries in prime-field ECDLP index calculus, together with stated limitations.
sources.note: Springer metadata and abstract were verified. No open primary manuscript was confirmed, and the full paper was not inspected in this iteration.

sources.title: Quantum Algorithm for Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithms with Space-Efficient Point Addition
sources.role: Current tracked logical-resource estimate for a quantum ECDLP implementation over a 256-bit prime-field curve.
sources.note: Reports 835 logical qubits and 2^30.63 Toffoli gates. This is an algorithmic logical-resource estimate, not evidence of available fault-tolerant hardware.

sources.title: Reducing Elliptic Curve Logarithms to Logarithms in a Finite Field
sources.role: MOV transfer to 𝔽_{p^k}^× via the Weil pairing — resisted by secp256k1's large embedding degree (secp256k1_embedding_degree_gt_100).

sources.title: Complexity of a determinate algorithm for the discrete logarithm
sources.role: Independent generic-group discrete-log lower bound (with Shoup), cited as the Shoup/Nechaev bound.

sources.title: Faster Algorithms for the ECDLP in the Large Characteristic Case (title as cited in the repo)
aliases: Faster Algorithms for the ECDLP in the Large Characteristic Case
sources.role: Composed low-degree rational maps for prime-field relation generation — the construction the P0 'petit' variant is explicitly NOT a faithful implementation of.
sources.note: Unverified legacy identity, retained separately from Petit–Kosters–Messeng 2016 because the title does not match and equivalence was not established. The broad alias 'Petit' was removed to prevent provenance conflation. Do not cite this record externally without identifying the underlying work.

sources.title: Algebraic Approaches for the Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithm Problem over Prime Fields
sources.role: Primary specification for composed low-degree rational-map factor bases and prime-field Semaev relation systems; required provenance for any faithful R-PETIT-COMPOSED-MAPS implementation.
sources.note: An open official IACR archival PDF exists. The earlier repository statement that this source was unavailable or only paywalled was incorrect. A full-text construction and term review found no GLV, automorphism, endomorphism, invariant-coordinate, or fixed-target symmetry claim; its relevance is the faithful composed-map factor-base construction, not overlap with the bounded GLV-SEMAEV-ITER-001 stabilizer result.

sources.title: An Improved Algorithm for Computing Logarithms over GF(p) and Its Cryptographic Significance
sources.role: Reduces DLP to prime-order subgroups — why cofactor-1 prime order n matters (PohligHellman.lean).

sources.title: Monte Carlo methods for index computation (mod p)
sources.role: Pollard rho — the O(√n) generic upper bound matching Shoup's lower bound (PollardRho.lean), giving generic DLP Θ(√n).

sources.title: Elliptic Curves over Finite Fields and the Computation of Square Roots mod p
sources.role: Polynomial-time point counting — the algorithm Mathlib lacks, so #E(𝔽ₚ)=n is pinned by native_decide rather than proved (the point-counting barrier).

sources.title: SEC 2: Recommended Elliptic Curve Domain Parameters, Version 2.0
sources.role: Primary standards source for the secp256k1 field, curve, generator, prime subgroup order, and cofactor parameters.
sources.note: Dated January 27, 2010; the official SECG site lists Version 2.0 as the finalized SEC 2 specification.

sources.title: Summation polynomials and the discrete logarithm problem on elliptic curves
sources.role: Introduces the summation polynomials Sₘ formalized (S₃/S₄) in SemaevThree.lean / SemaevFour.lean and studied in the P0 experiment.

sources.title: Algorithms for Quantum Computation: Discrete Logarithms and Factoring
sources.venue: 35th Annual Symposium on Foundations of Computer Science
sources.role: Foundational polynomial-time quantum route for discrete logarithms; kept separate from the classical threat model.

sources.title: Lower Bounds for Discrete Logarithms and Related Problems
sources.role: Generic-group lower bound Ω(√n) for the discrete log — the collision-counting core formalized in GenericGroupBound.lean.

sources.title: The Discrete Logarithm Problem on Elliptic Curves of Trace One
sources.role: Anomalous-curve (trace-one) attack — resisted because secp256k1 has trace t≠1 (secp256k1_trace_ordinary_nonanomalous / anomalous_iff_trace_one).
sources.note: Discovered independently by Smart, Satoh–Araki, and Semaev; cited here as Smart/SSSA.

sources.title: Algorithms in Invariant Theory
sources.venue: 2nd ed., Texts & Monographs in Symbolic Computation, Springer Vienna
sources.role: Textbook source for invariant rings of diagonal cyclic scalar actions, Veronese subalgebras, and the generator count used in the GLV-Semaev analysis.
sources.note: The iteration note cites the second edition. The underlying proposition first appeared in the 1993 edition; the metadata here is for the 2008 second edition.

sources.title: Index calculus attacks on hyperelliptic Jacobians with efficient endomorphisms
sources.role: Prior art for endomorphism-invariant factor bases and the literal j=0 map phi(x,y)=(beta*x,y) in extension-field index calculus.
sources.note: The open IACR preprint is titled with 'Effective Endomorphisms'; the published 2021 journal version uses 'efficient endomorphisms'. No DOI was confirmed.
